label: an upcoming output of j (looks ahead to j in the copy)
explanation: Fires ahead of the model having to output the letter j. In the delimiter and copy phases it fires when j is the current output or one of the next two outputs: 91% of steps that output j are active, and activation ramps up over the steps before the j. During input it fires from t>=3 onward when the sequence starts with j (orig(0) or orig(1) is j), i.e. while it holds the j that will be copied out first. The strongest activations (up to max) come from sequences beginning j j, late in the original phase and at <DEL>, and fade as the leading js are copied out. It is silent at t<2 and mostly quiet in sequences with no j. Misses (~30% of active steps, ~19% of mass) are weak activations: a j at an early-middle position seen during input, or lookahead further than 2 steps. False positives are mostly j outputs where the activation is weak or absent. Dev F1 0.69, mass recall 0.81.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: out_tok=j (+6.30), orig0=j (+5.41), next_out=j (+5.16), phase=2 & in_tok=j (+4.56), orig1=j (+4.23), phase=2 & out_tok=j (+4.17).
